title: An explicit power saving for the exact discrete Fourier transform
summary: We give a deterministic algorithm that computes the discrete Fourier transform at every length n in $`O(n(\log n)^{1-10^{-13}})`$ operations. The model uses exact complex arithmetic, unrestricted coefficients, specified Fourier roots, and unit-cost logarithmic-size indexing; scalar preparation and array organization are included.

review.reason: Presents a deterministic exact DFT algorithm with an improved log-factor operation count.
